name: Markdown
description: Edit a Markdown document with a docked agent: outline it, tighten a passage, proofread it and keep a table of contents, each change landing in the open buffer as one undo step.

commands.name: outline
commands.description: Summarise the document's structure, heading by heading.

action.prompt: Read {file} and give me its outline: one line per heading, with what each section says in a few words. Change nothing.

commands.name: tighten
commands.description: Tighten the selected passage, or the paragraph at the cursor.

action.prompt: Tighten the selected passage of {file} (or the paragraph at the cursor if nothing is selected): same meaning, fewer words. Edit the file in place.

commands.name: proofread
commands.description: Fix spelling, grammar and broken links, and list what changed.

action.prompt: Proofread {file}: fix spelling, grammar and broken Markdown links in place, change nothing else, and list each fix.

commands.name: toc
commands.description: Insert or refresh a table of contents under the title.

action.prompt: Insert a table of contents for {file} directly under its title, or refresh the one that is there, linking every ## and ### heading. Edit the file in place.
